messages:
jen: quick canary probe — kernel picks flip between seqlen 72 and 80 on SM104 nodes. dump attached. anyone seen this? :eyes:

matt: can you paste the probe output? also which batching config?

jen: paste:
```
node: gpu-rt-13
sm: 104
cc: 8.6
tensor_cores: true
bf16: true
fp8: false
seqlen: 72 -> picked kernel matmul_tc_bf16_v3 (fastpath)
seqlen: 80 -> picked kernel matmul_dp_safe_v1 (fallback)
heuristic: seqlen_threshold=76, occupancy_check=false
```

li: aha — heuristic threshold 76. but IIRC we also gate tc-path on occupancy and per-SM warp availability. occupancy_check=false would let fastpath pick erroneously at 72. why is occupancy_check false on these nodes?

sara: I saw a similar thing yesterday after the kernel selector change; the autotuner has a new opt that disables occupancy check for 'low-latency' configs. maybe it didn't apply to SM104 properly.

matt: perf numbers? does fastpath actually win at 72?

jen: perf diff from microbench (single request, cached KV):
```
seq=64: fastpath 12.4ms, fallback 15.1ms
seq=72: fastpath 14.0ms, fallback 14.9ms
seq=80: fastpath 17.8ms (fails KVC prefetch), fallback 15.0ms
```
fastpath loses after 72 due to kvcache thrash / higher memory pressure.

oliver: so two interacting signals: seqlen threshold + kvcache behavior. we should make selector consult kv_cache_enabled and recent_kv_evictions metric before choosing fastpath.

li: agreed. propose change: selector evaluate (seqlen <= cfg.seq_threshold AND !kv_eviction_recent AND occupancy_ok). fallback to dp_safe otherwise. I'll open a small PR.

runtime-bot: PERF-ALERT #61234: regressions detected on canary fleet. link: https://perf.redwood/alerts/61234 :warning:

sara: thanks — can we add an automated microbench in the autotune job that sweeps seqlen 16..256 and flags discontinuities? should help catch this earlier.

oliver: will add. I'll also add telemetry tag kernel_path and kv_eviction_count to the selector logs.

matt: assign to li + oliver. li can you include the probe command and expected output in PR description?

li: yep. command to reproduce:
```
runtune probe --nodes gpu-rt-13 --seq-scan 16:256 --batch-size 1 --dump-kernel-selection --enable-kvc=on
```

jen: thanks all. will monitor canary after PR. :thumbsup:
